summary: Mesoblast Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 18, 2026, furnishing a press release dated August 17, 2026. The announcement reports completion of patient treatment in the MSB-DR004 pivotal Phase 3 trial of rexlemestrocel-L for chronic low back pain, with 350 patients randomized and treated. The filing is a routine business update regarding clinical trial progress and does not involve any corporate transaction, shareholder action, or special-situation event. No deal terms, board actions, or advisory roles are mentioned. This is an operational milestone disclosure, not a special situation under event-driven investing criteria.
